uvMaskTool.title: Studio Iyan UV Mask Tool
uvMaskTool.copy: `Studio Iyan UV Mask Tool` is a Unity `Editor-only` utility for selecting UV islands or individual UV faces from a renderer's material slot and exporting the selected region as a `PNG` mask texture. It is built for avatar, outfit, prop, and texture-mask workflows that need precise UV-region extraction directly inside Unity.

cards.title: Best For
cards.body: VRChat avatars, outfits, props, and modular meshes that need precise texture masks from specific material-slot regions.

cards.title: Island and Face Selection
cards.body: You can select by UV island for fast broad targeting, or switch to per-face selection when only a narrow or irregular UV area should be masked.

cards.title: Brush and Overlay Workflow
cards.body: Version `1.3.0` adds face-paint drag selection, preview texture overlay, wireframe color control, and a pause toggle for Scene overlay updates while brushing.

cards.title: Editor Only
cards.body: The full workflow runs in the Unity Editor. At runtime, only the exported textures are expected to be used.

meta.body: Designed for Unity `2022.3+`, `MeshRenderer` or `SkinnedMeshRenderer` targets, meshes with usable UV data, and renderers that expose one or more material slots.

image.alt: Studio Iyan UV Mask Tool English UI screenshot
image.caption: Assign a renderer, choose the material slot, inspect UVs, switch between island and face selection, and export the selected region as a mask texture from one window.

sections.title: Key Features
items: Material-slot based UV triangle detection
UV island generation from the selected slot only
Island selection and individual face selection
Brush workflow for face selection with `LMB` paint and `RMB` erase
Preview texture overlay inside the UV preview
Zoomable and pannable UV preview
Configurable `UV Wireframe Color`
Separate `Preview Color` and exported `Selected Color`
Optional Scene View highlight for the selected region
Optional toggle to pause Scene overlay updates while brushing
`PNG` export with preset or custom resolution, alpha, padding, and anti-aliasing
English / Korean / Japanese UI support with saved language preference

sections.title: Requirements
items: Unity `2022.3` or newer
`MeshRenderer` or `SkinnedMeshRenderer`
A mesh with usable UV data
A renderer with one or more material slots
Editor-only usage

sections.title: Basic Usage
items: Open `Studio Iyan > Tools > UV Island Mask Generator`.
Assign a `MeshRenderer` or `SkinnedMeshRenderer`.
Choose the target `Material Slot`.
Inspect the generated UV region in the preview.
Select UV islands or switch to face mode for finer control.
Use drag painting in face mode if needed.
Set export resolution, alpha, colors, padding, and anti-aliasing.
Click `Export PNG` to save the selected area as a mask texture.

sections.title: How It Works
items: The tool reads the selected renderer.
It scans only the submesh triangles used by the chosen material slot.
Usable UV channels are detected automatically.
Connected UV triangles are grouped into islands.
You can select by island, by face, or by brush in face mode.
The selected region is rasterized into a `PNG` mask texture.

entries.title: `Renderer` / `Material Slot`
entries.body: Defines the working mesh target and the material slot whose submesh triangles should be scanned for UV generation.

entries.title: `UV Preview` / `Preview Texture`
entries.body: Shows the UV layout for the selected slot and can overlay either a manually assigned texture or the current material's main texture.

entries.title: `Selection Mode`
entries.body: Supports island mode and face mode. Face mode in `1.3.0` supports drag-based painting and erasing instead of click-only selection.

entries.title: `Scene View Highlight`
entries.body: Highlights the actual mesh triangles that correspond to the selected UV region. For `SkinnedMeshRenderer`, the Scene overlay is aligned to the current pose / transform.

entries.title: `Preview and Color Controls`
entries.body: Supports `UV Wireframe Color`, separate `Preview Color`, export `Selected Color`, optional preview texture overlay, and a pause toggle for Scene overlay updates while brushing.

entries.title: `Export Settings`
entries.body: Supports preset resolutions `256`, `512`, `1024`, `2048`, `4096`, custom resolution up to `8192`, alpha, background and selected colors, padding, and anti-aliasing.

sections.title: Tips
items: Choose the material slot first so the correct UV region is isolated before selection.
Island mode is fastest on clean UV layouts, while face mode is better for narrow or irregular mask regions.
Preview texture overlay makes it much easier to confirm selection against the real texture.
High resolutions and `SSAA 4x` can consume a lot of memory, so large exports should be handled carefully.
If Unity cannot read the mesh data correctly, confirm that the model import settings allow mesh data access.

entries.title: The mesh cannot be found
entries.body: For `MeshRenderer`, confirm that a `MeshFilter` exists on the same GameObject and that `sharedMesh` is assigned. For `SkinnedMeshRenderer`, verify that `sharedMesh` is connected correctly.

entries.title: The material slot list is empty
entries.body: Check that the renderer actually has material slots and that the selected submesh contains valid triangles. Empty submeshes may be skipped.

entries.title: No usable UV channels are detected
entries.body: Make sure the mesh contains UV data and that the selected material-slot triangles have non-zero UV area.

entries.title: UV islands are not generated
entries.body: Detection can fail if UVs overlap heavily or if only zero-area triangles exist. Try another material slot or review the automatically detected UV channel results.

entries.title: `Export PNG` is disabled
entries.body: Confirm that a renderer and material slot are selected, at least one island or face is chosen, and the resolution remains between `1` and `8192`.
